items.title: Fork into installable Claude Code plugin
items.note: Secaudit is now a one-step installable plugin with sharper, more focused security checks and new coverage for Expo, React Native, and Convex apps.

items.title: Comprehensive coverage and cited sources
items.note: Every security check is now backed by cited sources, and the audit covers the full OWASP Top 10 with new checks for cryptography, web vulnerabilities (XSS, SSRF, file uploads), and security logging.

items.title: Live CVE and advisory lookup
items.note: Version and dependency checks now look up the latest published security advisories as they run, so you're alerted to newly disclosed issues instead of relying only on a built-in list.

items.title: Dynamic verification against the running app
items.note: The audit can now optionally run your app and actively test it to confirm real vulnerabilities and filter out false alarms.

items.title: Risk-ranked scoping, finding verification, and admin-surface review
items.note: Audits now start with your highest-risk areas, can zero in on a single part of your app such as the admin area, and double-check each finding before reporting it.

items.title: Redact secrets in audit output (Snyk W007)
items.note: Security audits now mask any secrets they find in their reports instead of repeating the real values, so running an audit can't itself leak a credential into logs or transcripts.

items.title: Diff/PR-scoped audit mode
items.note: You can now point the audit at just your current branch or a pull request's changes, getting a fast, focused review of what you changed instead of the whole app.

items.title: Attack-chain construction in reports
items.note: Audit reports now connect related weaknesses into a single step-by-step attack path, so you can see how separate issues combine into a real-world risk.

items.title: Recon and coverage-gap phases
items.note: Audits now begin by mapping your app's attack surface and end with a check for anything the sweep missed, making the review more thorough.

items.title: Evidence-backed findings (anti-hallucination)
items.note: Every reported issue is now backed by a verified spot in your code and a concrete attack path, so you get fewer false alarms.

items.title: Cross-reference official Convex/Expo build skills
items.note: When auditing Convex or Expo apps, the audit now points you to the official build guides for those platforms and checks their recommended security settings.

items.title: Correct wrong CVE fix-versions in framework-versions
items.note: Version-check advice now points at genuinely patched releases; several entries previously named a version that was still vulnerable.

items.title: Remap OWASP Top 10 citations to the 2025 edition
items.note: All OWASP category references now match the current 2025 Top 10 numbering.

items.title: Update AI skill to LLM Top 10 2026 and MCP 2026-07-28 spec
items.note: AI and MCP guidance now tracks the 2026 LLM Top 10 and the current Model Context Protocol revision.

items.title: Add ChainDrop npm worm and no-CVE detection to supply-chain
items.note: Dependency checks no longer rely on advisory scanners alone, so a compromised package that was never formally reported can still be caught.

items.title: Fix dead and redirected source URLs
items.note: Repairs one dead documentation link and four that had moved.

items.title: Add 2026 Next.js middleware-bypass wave and CISA KEV entries
items.note: The version check now recognises a recent group of framework authentication flaws, including two that are known to be under active attack.

items.title: Self-checking freshness script for hardcoded versions and links
items.note: Adds a script that re-checks every version and link the skills cite, so outdated advice is caught automatically instead of drifting unnoticed.

items.title: Add prisma-security skill (Prisma, Postgres RLS, pgvector)
items.note: New checks for projects using Prisma with Postgres, including tenant isolation and vector search used by AI features.

items.title: Add better-auth-security skill
items.note: New checks for apps built with Better Auth, covering session handling, organization roles, and account linking.

items.title: Add docker-security skill
items.note: New checks for containerised projects, covering image contents, published ports, and runtime permissions.

items.title: Add python-web-security skill (FastAPI, Django)
items.note: New checks for Python backends built with FastAPI or Django.

items.title: Extend ai-integration with chat and RAG application layer
items.note: AI checks now cover chat apps end to end, including conversation history, retrieval, and how tools are given access to data.

items.title: Extend data-access, supply-chain and logging-monitoring for Python
items.note: Existing checks now recognise Python equivalents alongside the JavaScript ones.

items.title: Freshness check misses versions named as a CVE fix
items.note: The automated freshness check now also verifies versions named as a fix for a specific issue, catching outdated upgrade advice it previously skipped.

items.title: Add coverage for Nuxt, React Router, Vite and Node.js
items.note: Version checks now cover several more widely used frameworks and the Node.js runtime itself.

items.title: Extend dynamic-verification to containers
items.note: When a container is running, the audit can now confirm container findings against it instead of reporting them as suspected.

items.title: Add mcp-agent-security skill
items.note: New checks for apps that connect AI agents to external tools, covering the permissions those connections are granted.

items.title: Parallel subagent fan-out for whole-app audits
items.note: Whole-app audits now run each area in its own worker, so large projects get read thoroughly instead of sampled.

items.title: Add EPSS exploitation scoring and endoflife.date runtime EOL
items.note: Findings are now ranked by how likely an issue is to actually be exploited, and the audit flags runtimes that no longer receive security updates.

items.title: Add revenuecat-security skill (mobile IAP)
items.note: New checks for apps selling subscriptions through mobile in-app purchase.

items.title: Add Clerk coverage to auth
items.note: New checks for apps using Clerk for sign-in.

items.title: Add object-storage-security skill (R2, S3, Supabase Storage)
items.note: New checks for file and image storage, covering who can read uploaded files and for how long.

items.title: Continuous dependency monitoring for app repos
items.note: A drop-in scheduled check that watches an app's own dependencies and tells you which issues are actually being exploited, instead of listing everything that could be updated.

items.title: Close verified gaps in payments and supply-chain
items.note: Payment webhook checks now cover replayed and duplicated events, sender verification, and secret rotation; dependency checks verify lockfiles use secure download URLs.
